title: The hero button uses last year's blue
body:
## Problem

`index.html`'s hero button is styled in `style.css` with `.hero-button { background: #2196f3; }` — last year's blue. Brand guidelines moved to `#0B5FFD` in Q2 and this page never got the memo.

## What to do

Change `.hero-button`'s `background` in `style.css` to `#0B5FFD`. Nothing else on the page changes.

## Done when

- `style.css`'s `.hero-button` rule reads `background: #0B5FFD;`.
- `npm run dev` (`python3 -m http.server 4173`, per `package.json`) still serves `index.html` with no errors.
